headers.warning_signs: GO TO THE HOSPITAL AT ONCE IF

templates.warning_line: Seek emergency medical help if you experience {text}.

common_warnings.shortness of breath: difficulty breathing or shortness of breath
common_warnings.persistent vomiting: persistent vomiting or unable to keep fluids down
common_warnings.bleeding: unusual bleeding or blood in cough or stool
common_warnings.wound redness: increasing redness, swelling, or discharge from wound site

common_diet.low salt diet: Follow a low salt diet; avoid pickles, papad, and salted snacks
common_diet.diabetic diet: Follow a diabetic diet; avoid sugar, sweets, and refined carbohydrates
common_diet.soft diet: Eat soft, easily digestible food for the next few days
common_diet.high protein diet: Eat protein-rich foods such as dal, eggs, and boiled pulses
common_diet.adequate hydration: Drink plenty of clean water throughout the day unless restricted

common_activity.avoid heavy lifting: Avoid lifting heavy objects for 4 weeks
common_activity.bed rest: Strict bed rest for 3 days; avoid exertion
common_activity.deep breathing exercises: Practice gentle deep breathing exercises 3 times daily
common_activity.regular walking: Take light 15-minute walks twice daily as tolerated
